=== a hello-world syscall program
        global _start
        section .text
_start:
        mov     rax, 1
        mov     rdi, 1
        lea     rsi, [rel msg]
        mov     edx, msglen
        syscall
        mov     rax, 60
        xor     rdi, rdi
        syscall
        section .rodata
msg:    db      "Hello, world!", 10
msglen  equ     $ - msg
=== data sections and symbols
        global x, y
        global f:function
        global obj:data (obj_end - obj)
        section .data
x:      dd      1
y:      dq      2
        section .text
f:      ret
        section .bss
obj:    resb    16
obj_end:
=== externs and relocations
        extern printf
        extern value
        global main
        section .text
main:
        call    printf
        mov     eax, [rel value]
        lea     rdi, [rel value]
        mov     rax, value
        ret
        section .data
        dq      value
        dd      main
=== relative and absolute data
        global start
        section .text
start:  nop
a:      nop
b:      nop
        section .data
        dd      b - a
        dd      a - b
        dq      a
        dd      start
tab:    dd      a - tab, b - tab
=== wrt relocations
        extern ext
        global f
        section .text
f:
        call    ext wrt ..plt
        mov     rax, [rel ext wrt ..got]
        section .data
        dq      ext wrt ..got
        dd      ext wrt ..sym
        dq      ext wrt ..gotoff
=== local labels across sections
        section .text
        global outer
outer:
        jmp     .next
.next:
        jmp     .done
.done:
        ret
second:
.x:     ret
        dd      outer.next - outer
=== default rel
        default rel
        extern g
        global f
        section .text
f:
        mov     eax, [g]
        lea     rsi, [g]
        mov     rax, [abs g]
        ret
=== struc in a data section
        struc pixel
        .r: resb 1
        .g: resb 1
        .b: resb 1
        .a: resb 1
        endstruc
        section .data
        global first
first:  istruc pixel
        at pixel.r, db 0xff
        at pixel.g, db 0x80
        at pixel.a, db 0xff
        iend
        dd      pixel_size
=== a macro library
%macro syscall3 4
        mov     rax, %1
        mov     rdi, %2
        mov     rsi, %3
        mov     rdx, %4
        syscall
%endmacro
        global _start
        section .text
_start:
        syscall3 1, 1, buf, 4
        syscall3 60, 0, 0, 0
        section .bss
buf:    resb    4
